[[Ascalonian Refugee]]s are [[NPC]]s that provides the [[Vanguard Patrol]] blessing. When first talked to, with at least 25 kills, you receive a [[Vanguard Patrol#Random bonuses|bonus]]. When awarded bonus reputation points, the bonus is greater with more kills.

==Locations==
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Charr Homelands]]
***{{NPC location|Dalada Uplands}}
***{{NPC location|Grothmar Wardowns}}
***{{NPC location|Sacnoth Valley}}

==Dialogue==
=== Not under [[Vanguard Patrol]] ===
: ''"I am not a hero. I am no fighter. But I can do my part to help the Ebon Vanguard."'' 
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = For Ascalon!
| accepticon = [[File:Vanguard Patrol.jpg|20px]]
| decline = Not right now.
| ask = Ascalon isn't lost forever. She's still waiting for us. We just have to find the way home. Maybe we need more heroes.
}}
=== Under Vanguard Patrol ===
;Less than 25 kills
: ''"Hmm. '''(0...24)''' kills? Come back when you've got a few more."''

;After 25 kills
:''"I thought I heard the Ebon Vanguard pass through here. I'll let them know you have '''(25...49)''' kills when I see them."''

;After 50 kills
:''"'''(50...99)''' is a good number of kills, but think of all those killed in [[the Searing]]..."''

;After 100 kills
: ''"I bet one of those scouts five gold that you'd get to '''(100...x)''' kills, and you did! I don't know what I will spend it on. Food. Maybe new shoes."''

===After reaching Ebon Vanguard rank 1, before receiving [[Rebel Yell]]===
: ''"Tales of your heroics are spreading. I have heard that '''[[Gedrel of Ascalon]] [Vanguard Herald]''' in the '''[[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]]''' wishes to discuss your exploits."''

=== Not under [[Veteran Vanguard Patrol]] ===
;If male
: ''"With heroes like you on our side, Ascalon will never truly be lost. Thank you for showing me that bravery still exists in this cold world."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = For Ascalon!
| accepticon = [[File:Veteran Vanguard Patrol.jpg|20px]]
| decline = Not right now.
| ask = With heroes like you on our side, Ascalon will never truly be lost. Thank you for showing that me {{sic|should be "me that"}} bravery still exists in this cold world.
}}

;If female
:''"Even in this cold world, truly brave actions can still warm the hearts of good soldiers. Thank you, hero, for showing me the way."''
